results.title: Native host and renderer inventory
results.test_environment: Interactive local desktop, Built-in Retina Display, Godot 4.7.1
results.direct_evidence: DisplayServer=macOS, renderer=gl_compatibility/opengl3, video_adapter=Apple M4, one 2x display.

results.title: Per-pixel transparency
results.test_environment: Interactive Minimal over neutral Godot underlay
results.direct_evidence: Underlay remains visible through fully transparent overlay pixels while the placeholder is opaque.

results.title: Alpha-edge quality
results.direct_evidence: Soft alpha edges render without an opaque window rectangle or black fringe in the captured composition.

results.title: Borderless native window
results.direct_evidence: Diagnostics reported window_borderless=true; capture shows pet-only overlay without title bar or frame.

results.title: Always-on-top enabled
results.test_environment: Interactive Small above active neutral underlay
results.direct_evidence: Small remained visibly above the active underlay; diagnostics reported always_on_top=true.

results.title: Always-on-top disabled
results.direct_evidence: The underlay covered the overlay normally; diagnostics reported always_on_top=false.

results.title: Whole-window mouse passthrough
results.test_environment: Interactive Minimal over neutral clickable underlay
results.direct_evidence: Underlay click_count changed 7 to 8 at [242,242]; overlay_click_count remained 0.

results.title: Polygon interior receives input
reproduction: Click inside the current placeholder polygon.
results.direct_evidence: Overlay logged a click at [122,124] and overlay_click_count became 1.

results.title: Polygon exterior passes to underlying app
reproduction: Click inside native window bounds but outside the current polygon.
results.direct_evidence: Underlay received local [340,288]; overlay_click_count remained 0.

results.title: Moving hit region follows placeholder
results.test_environment: Interactive Minimal with animated technical placeholder
reproduction: Observe F9 counters for two seconds in hit-region mode.
results.direct_evidence: Polygon diagnostics changed with the placeholder; counter increased exactly 60 times in two seconds after throttling.

results.title: Native dragging
reproduction: Press and drag the Drag control from [370,162] to [470,242].
results.direct_evidence: Window position changed [400,300] to [590,452] through Window.start_drag().

results.title: Focus acquisition in normal mode
results.test_environment: Interactive Small with neutral underlay active
results.direct_evidence: Godot became frontmost and window_focused=true.

results.title: Focus avoidance while already inactive
results.direct_evidence: Minimal remained window_focused=false after the polygon click.

results.title: Focused Small to Minimal releases focus
results.test_environment: Interactive focused Small transitioning to Minimal
results.direct_evidence: unfocusable=true and no_focus were applied, but window_focused stayed true and Godot remained frontmost.

results.title: Application activation behavior
results.direct_evidence: Normal Small activation worked; changing to unfocusable Minimal did not deactivate an already active app.

results.title: Cmd+Tab visibility and behavior
reproduction: Inspect Cmd+Tab manually in each mode.
results.direct_evidence: Not executed to a reliable, privacy-safe result.

results.title: Dock presence
results.test_environment: Interactive local desktop with auto-hide Dock
reproduction: Launch the spike and reveal the Dock manually.
results.direct_evidence: A Godot application entry was observed, but no privacy-safe artifact was retained.

results.title: Dock restoration
results.test_environment: Interactive local desktop with auto-hide Dock
reproduction: Minimize then restore through the Dock manually.
results.direct_evidence: Unreliable coordinate-based Dock automation was aborted and is not evidence.

results.title: Minimize
results.direct_evidence: Direct borderless minimize was ignored. Temporarily restoring native decoration produced window_mode=1 and focused=false.

results.title: Hide main window
results.direct_evidence: Godot error: Can't change visibility of main window. Adapter now returns MAIN_WINDOW_HIDE_UNSUPPORTED.

results.title: Restore after minimize or hide
reproduction: Restore from a native recovery control after minimize/hide.
results.direct_evidence: Not completed; hide is unsupported and the status item was not usable.

results.title: Native close lifecycle
reproduction: Use the native close request and verify save/cleanup/reopen.
results.direct_evidence: Runs were stopped from the test harness; native close behavior was not isolated.

results.title: Reopen with saved position
results.direct_evidence: Minimal [24,58], Small [400,300], and Expanded [1600,1124] placements were loaded on later runs.

results.title: Mission Control behavior
reproduction: Open Mission Control in each mode and return.
results.direct_evidence: Not executed to a reliable result.

results.title: Spaces behavior
reproduction: Move between configured Spaces and observe the overlay.
results.direct_evidence: Not executed to a reliable result.

results.title: Stage Manager behavior
reproduction: Read the existing WindowManager setting without changing it.
results.direct_evidence: com.apple.WindowManager GloballyEnabled=0; no Stage Manager run was available.

results.title: Show Desktop behavior
reproduction: Invoke Show Desktop in each mode and restore.
results.direct_evidence: Not executed to a reliable result.

results.title: Retina scaling and coordinate conversion
reproduction: Capture Godot monitor diagnostics and native window geometry.
results.direct_evidence: Godot reported scale=2.0 and dpi=225; pointer hit tests and window placements resolved consistently in logical screen coordinates.

results.title: Menu-bar and Dock usable-area bounds
reproduction: Compare screen rect and usable rect diagnostics.
results.direct_evidence: Full [0,0,2560,1664], usable [0,58,2560,1606]; 58-pixel menu-bar exclusion, no persistent Dock exclusion under auto-hide.

results.title: Placement near every screen edge
results.test_environment: Interactive single Retina display plus headless geometry tests
reproduction: Place Minimal at top-left and Expanded at bottom-right.
results.direct_evidence: Top-left and bottom-right were observed natively; all-edge clamping passed synthetically, not as four native screenshots.

results.title: Multiple monitors
results.direct_evidence: Godot reported one display; additional hardware was unavailable.

results.title: Differing scale factors
reproduction: Enumerate scale for every attached display.
results.direct_evidence: No second differently scaled display was attached.

results.title: Negative real display coordinates
results.direct_evidence: Available hardware had no negative-coordinate display; synthetic negative coordinates passed headlessly.

results.title: Lost-display recovery
results.direct_evidence: Removed-monitor fallback, normalized restore, off-screen recovery, changed resolution, and oversized clamping passed.

results.title: Minimal, Small, Expanded transitions
results.test_environment: Interactive native window plus headless state tests
results.direct_evidence: Native sizes/positions changed correctly and 106 logical applications preserved one presentation; focused-to-Minimal deactivation failed.

results.title: Menu-bar status item visibility
reproduction: Launch the spike and inspect the menu bar.
results.direct_evidence: StatusIndicator reported visible=true with rect [-9120,-6,44,64], but the generated indicator was not visible in the menu-bar capture.

results.title: Status-item recovery controls
reproduction: Open the generated status menu and invoke restore.
results.direct_evidence: No visible/actionable status item was available, so recovery callbacks could not be validated.

results.title: Godot platform-neutral validation
results.direct_evidence: 41 assertions passed; ENV-HEADLESS-002 explicitly proves the headless session is rejected as native-window evidence.

results.title: Minimal idle CPU and memory
reproduction: Sample process CPU and resident memory four times.
results.direct_evidence: Mean CPU 5.6%; top memory 89 MiB; ps RSS 213632 KiB. Values are approximate and memory tools disagree.

results.title: Dynamic region update cost
results.direct_evidence: Exactly 60 updates in two seconds. Separate CPU samples do not establish a reduction.

results.title: Per-process GPU use
reproduction: Use an available per-process GPU counter without installing tooling.
results.direct_evidence: No reliable per-process GPU counter was available in the test environment.

results.title: Small and Expanded idle resources
reproduction: Stabilize and sample each mode separately.
results.direct_evidence: No isolated Small or Expanded idle sample set was retained.
